items.title: Free Arched Floral Mandala DXF Door Panel for CNC Cutting
items.description: A domed, arch-topped silhouette is filled edge to edge with layered floral mandalas and small circular cutouts. The dense repetition of blossoms across the full height gives this piece a lush, garden-arbor character, well suited to entryway gates or decorative screen doors with a rounded top profile.
